title: HadithSpanAnchors
description: GLM output contract for Phase 4b. GLM copies short anchor phrases from the input; it never returns offsets, never rewrites text and never assigns grades. Code locates anchors in the ORIGINAL text (NFC + diacritic-insensitive) and computes offsets.

spans.description: One item per hadith narration or takhrij reference in the input window. Empty if none. Editor notes in [[...]] are never hadith spans.

start_anchor.description: The first 3-8 words of the hadith span, copied exactly from the input (diacritics may be omitted).

end_anchor.description: The last 3-8 words of the hadith span, copied exactly from the input (diacritics may be omitted).

cue.description: The introducing formula as written, e.g. 'قال الإمام أحمد: حدثنا', 'وقد رواه مسلم'.

collection_hint.description: Collection named in the span itself (not guessed). 'other' for a named source outside this list.

number_hint.description: A hadith number written in the span itself, copied as written (Arabic-Indic digits allowed). Never from memory.

x-locator-rules: Match on normalized copies (NFC, diacritics stripped, alef/ya/ta-marbuta unified) with an offset map back to the original text.
start = first match of start_anchor at or after the window start; end = end of the first match of end_anchor at or after start.
end is extended first over the diacritics (Unicode Mn) of the last letter, then over directly following closing marks: " ” » ) ] ﴾ (no other characters).

Normalization strips Mn per original character (the offset map has one entry per kept character); this makes NFC re-ordering irrelevant. Checked on the T0.5 fixture: anchors give exactly [141, 657) and [658, 790).
Anchor matches inside a [[...]] footnote are skipped (the next match outside is used). If no match outside footnotes exists, the span is rejected and logged with the run id; it is never guessed.
Located spans become Span {type: HADITH} with provenance method='glm', source='run:<id>', confidence from agreement across runs.
